explain.say: Start at the bottom left: London, on the Prime Meridian at 0 degrees. Time here is called UTC, the world’s starting clock, much like the old Greenwich Mean Time. Every other time zone is counted as hours ahead of it or behind it.

explain.say: The Earth spins once, 360 degrees, in 24 hours. 360 divided by 24 is 15, so every 15 degrees means one hour. Dhaka in Bangladesh is 90 degrees east, and 90 divided by 15 is 6. Can you see Dhaka’s dot at 6 hours ahead?

faq.q: Why are there different time zones?
faq.a: The Earth spins, so the sun rises at different moments in different places. Time zones let noon on the clock come roughly when the sun is highest, wherever you live.
asks: Why is it night in Japan when it is day in Britain?

faq.q: Why does every 15 degrees make one hour?
faq.a: The Earth turns 360 degrees in 24 hours. 360 divided by 24 is 15, so the Earth turns 15 degrees every hour.
asks: How many degrees is one time zone?

faq.a: UTC, Coordinated Universal Time, is the world’s reference clock, set at 0 degrees longitude like the old Greenwich Mean Time. Time zones are written as UTC plus or minus hours, like UTC plus 9 for Tokyo.

faq.q: Why does China have only one time zone?
faq.a: China is wide enough for about five time zones, but since 1949 the whole country has used Beijing time, 8 hours ahead of UTC. In the far west, winter sunrise can come around 10 in the morning by the clock.
asks: How many time zones does China have?

faq.q: Why is India 5 and a half hours ahead?
faq.a: India uses one time for the whole country, set by a line at 82.5 degrees east. 82.5 divided by 15 is 5.5, so India Standard Time is 5 and a half hours ahead of UTC.

facts: India Standard Time is UTC+5:30, based on the 82.5°E line of longitude.
China has used a single time zone, UTC+8, since 1949.
Nepal uses UTC+5:45, one of the few time zones with a 45-minute offset.

quiz.say: A city is 45 degrees east of Greenwich. How many hours ahead of UTC is its sun time?
quiz.show: A city 45 degrees east is ahead of UTC by…
quiz.why: Every 15 degrees is one hour, and 45 divided by 15 is 3.

wrong.1: 45 is the number of degrees; divide by 15 to get hours.
wrong.2: 15 is the number of degrees in one hour, not the answer.

quiz.say: Why are places in the east ahead in time?
quiz.show: Places to the east are ahead in time because…

options.show: They see the sunrise first as the Earth spins
options.say: They see the sunrise first as the Earth spins

options.show: They are closer to the sun
options.say: They are closer to the sun

quiz.why: The Earth spins towards the east, so eastern places meet the morning sun first.

wrong.1: All places on Earth are about the same distance from the sun.
wrong.2: All clocks tick at the same speed; only the starting time is different.
